name: stride
description: Stride: full-stack health and fitness planner (React + Express + SQLite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stride/engine && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
